name: Sugardrop Breakout
original_name: シュガードロップ・ブレイクアウト
source:
After her 12th birthday, Princess Margot left the mansion she had grown up in and returned to her original residence, Castle Avalon.

It was her father, whom she met for the first time, who welcomed her to the imperial capital. One day, at an evening party, the princess met a young nobleman while she was inevitably involved in a ugly battle between nobles over her imperial throne.

Rodis, the only son of the Duke of Castagnier, was one of her relatives and a kind young man──

[Translated from [url=http://sugar.f-sp.net/]official website[/url]]
translation:
12岁生日过后，玛歌特公主离开了自己长大的宅邸，回到了原本的居所——阿瓦隆城堡。

迎接她来到帝都的，是她初次谋面的父亲。某天，在一场晚会上，公主在不可避免地卷入贵族间围绕皇位的丑陋争斗时，邂逅了一位年轻贵族。

罗迪斯是卡斯塔涅尔公爵的独子，也是她的亲戚，一位温柔善良的年轻人──

[译自[url=http://sugar.f-sp.net/]官方网站[/url]]
